policy.snapshot_source: seq23/search-loop config/free-models.json at origin/main, 2026-11-06 (prices read from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models by the engine)

router: The only code in this repo that calls a model is the shared search-loop engine (seq23/search-loop src/llm.mjs), run by .github/workflows/search-loop.yml. search-loop.config.json points it at this file (llm.routing_file); the engine fails loud unless max_cost_usd is 0, fallback_to_paid is false and every model is priced $0/$0. Its other lanes are the Gemini free tier (no-billing project) and a metered share of the free Workers AI daily allowance; there is no paid lane. scripts/tests/zero-paid.test.mjs proves this file and that no other code calls a model endpoint.
